scientific_integrity.claim_type: mathematical proof supported by standalone exact-checking code
scientific_integrity.evidence: Finite-support variance peak theorem; exact three-species example; analytic separated-scale construction for each finite species count

scientific_limitations: iid sampling with replacement; no inference for spatially structured or imperfect-detection surveys
The analytic construction gives at least m-1 strict maxima but no universal fixed-m upper bound
Separated probabilities may require enormous sampling effort to resolve peaks
Priority relative to broader finite-urn results is provisional; two plausible original sources could not be fully read
title: Repeated richness uncertainty peaks from separated species abundances
